blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Manila North Cemetery recorded more than 1.3 million visitors on Sunday, All Saints’ Day. Based on the cemetery’s crowd monitoring update, an estimated 1,326,800 people visited their departed loved ones before it closed for the day on Nov. 1. This was despite the high heat and a sudden downpour around noon.
